what: a single short, wide leather ankle boot for a thick-legged wearer's foot, seen from above so that it is strongly foreshortened
reads: The boot points toward the bottom of the picture. The large ring at the top is the ankle collar seen from above: it is as wide as the whole foot and stands straight up toward the camera, so it hides the heel and the back half of the foot. Only the front half of the foot shows below the ring: a short stretch of instep directly under the ring, then the broad, blunt, rounded toe at the bottom, so the whole boot is a compact shape about one and a half times as tall as the ring. The wide round opening inside the ring is where the thick leg goes in, a clean hole, and the plain {ground} background fills it from rim to rim.
look: a plain sturdy work boot of matte medium brown leather with a smooth rounded toe, thin dark brown cord laces crossing three times over the instep, and a short ankle collar split at the front
paint: Turn the simple forms into believable worn leather in the swatch's colours, every detail fitted inside the block-out's own compact outline: the ring as a thick leather ankle collar that keeps the block-out's full width, wall thickness and wide round opening, its front edge parting in a small V; three close crossings of thin dark brown cord lace through small eyelets on the short instep directly below the collar; a smooth, plain, broad rounded toe with one soft tan highlight; two thin dark seam lines curving from the lacing down each side to the sole; a slim darker welt line following the edge of the sole around the toe; and a few soft creases
material: matte medium brown leather with its soft lighter tan highlights, thin dark brown seam lines and thin dark brown cord laces
hole_words: and the round opening of the cuff
